notes.title: About the "Demo"
notes.content:
I just wanted to say that the game is going to change a lot before the next demo.
[list]
[*] There will be [b]more[/b] things to punch, grab, and throw...
[*] There will be less [i]permanent[/i] abilities and menu stuff 
because items in the menu will take different forms.
[*] The map will be more metroidvania, and less sandbox.
[/list]
That said, I hope you enjoy this beta for what it is. Try grabbing many things. Be sure to find the dash button, press down to roll, and don't miss the dungeon to the left. (It's like half the 'demo'!) 

...and sorry for all the bugs!

notes.title: Happy New Year!!
notes.content:
Happy new years!

New years resolution: Get this demo out as soon as possible.

Holidays have been kinda rough. I'm still getting over an infection/illness, but I really hope to release a new public demo before the end of the month. Wish me luck, thanks for readin, bye bye :)

notes.title: Still here, still at it!
notes.content:
Hello!

Sorry for the delay!!

Good news: Made a lot of progress on the much needed demo boss lately. Still have a little bit of dungeon design to go over, some sound effects and music to do as well, and general bug fixing. 

It's easy to tunnel focus on the game and forget to do updates such as this.
I'll post the next update sooner (like in 2 weeks instead of 2 months), pinky swear!

If you want to spoil some of the surprises you can check out the game on twitter @homegrovegame, or stop by the stream at http://twitch.tv/flipswitchx

Oh, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Demo Incoming
notes.content:
Hi all. Time for a bit of mixed news.

To be honest I always knew October 1st was too early, but I was hoping things would go a little more smoothly!

I had to move, and find a part-time job, and deal with other things. My engine has gone through several updates, which has been great, but I've also had to deal with a variety of issues in regard to that. Basically, life's hard, but I've been doing valuable and necessary work.

Everything I'm working on right now is going toward a [b]full public demo[/b], not just for beta testers. Keyboard input, for the many people without a controller. Music and sound design, and gameplay not seen in the currently outdated trailer. (Dungeon, boss fight, side quests, etc.) 

Homegrove IS coming. Hope you keep it in your heart, or at least, the back of your mind.

Thanks for tuning in!  =)

notes.title: Howdy! It's the first announcement!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has been following and waiting patiently!

In case you didn't know, Homegrove is a solo project, though getting this far wouldn't have been possible without the various support (emotional, financial, technical) that I've received in the last few years. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart to everyone that has contributed!

From day to day my thoughts are on Homegrove, and how to complete it faster without sacrificing my original vision. I'm really trying to outdo myself.

Unfortunately, it just isn't ready yet, but I do intend to release a small demo in April, and a bigger one later on.

As for projected release date? It will most likely move 6 months ahead, but even that is not a guarantee. I know! I'm sorry! This might come as a shock to some people who have been looking forward to it, but I hope the demos help ease the pain. 

Also, I intend to make announcements on progress more frequently from this point onward.

Please look forward to them! Thank you!

[i]The Discord channel: https://discord.gg/hVfHRxu[/i]
